edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: Systemic inflammatory spillover and insulin-resistance signaling may help connect periodontal disease with PCOS-related metabolic burden.
edges.summary: The strongest piece here is the 2025 Bitonti meta analysis in Dent J (Basel), which ties periodontal disease to polycystic ovary syndrome in a direction that later studies largely support. That makes this edge more about calibrating magnitude and context than arguing over whether the signal exists at all.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
